# config family ran with the scratch engine's data/pack moved aside (plain
# emission path, not the merge-compare path). Procedure: rev-244 B7 plan
# Tasks 1-3 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-06-rev244-b7-unpack.md), re-run
# at the 254 pins per the rev-254 plan Task 28.
# Generated 2026-06-11. Sections: ADDED/MODIFIED/DELETED (+CACHE-*) = content
# (resp. cache-dir) changed-set with sha256 of post-run bytes; WROTE = files
# (re)written by the run incl. identical-bytes rewrites (mtime-based; CACHE:
# prefix = cache dir; PackFile module-load registry rewrites subtracted;
# renameSync moves preserve mtime so renames appear in ADDED/DELETED only);
# STDOUT-NORM = sha256 of stdout with per-line 'M/D/YYYY H:MM:SS AM\t LEVEL\t '
# TS-Logger prefixes stripped.
# NEW at 254: pack/category.pack is ALSO subtracted from the changed-set —
# TS validateCategoryPack (PackFile.ts:130-145 @2e3bcf43) regenerates it at
# module load whenever any .loc/.npc/.obj source is mtime-newer (always true
# in a fresh scratch copy) and the committed bytes at Content caee3f2e are
# stale vs that regeneration; module-load noise, not unpack-family behavior.
